concepts.name: 青瓷工作台
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished high-fidelity desktop game interface concept for a new DBX Mahjong plugin, landscape 16:10, approximately 1600x1000 pixels. This is an actual application screen showing a playable four-person Chinese Mahjong table, not a marketing poster, not a collage, no physical monitor or desk. Primary brief: exceed an earlier cluttered DouDB card-game plugin through a clearer, cohesive design. Integrate DBX database-workbench identity subtly through fine grid alignment, a tiny database cylinder mark on tile backs, monospaced seat labels and a small DBX connection-ready dot. Do not add any database mechanics to Mahjong. Traditional Chinese Mahjong faces must stay traditional: 万、筒、条、东南西北、中发白, no SQL or database symbols on tile faces. Standard four-seat table, human bottom, Redis on the right, PostgreSQL opposite at top, MySQL on the left. Opponents have concealed racks of matching tile backs. Four tidy small discard rivers surround a compact central wind compass with 东、南、西、北 and a clear current-turn indicator, label "东风东局" and "余牌 68". Human's 14 large ivory mahjong tiles line the bottom of the table in one uncluttered row, one newly drawn tile separated slightly, one selected tile raised slightly. Show a few small flower tiles discreetly beside a rack. Human hand and latest discard are the strongest visual elements. Essential action bar immediately above the hand: "提示" and primary "出牌"; short status "轮到你出牌". A thin application header reads "DBX" at the far left, small active tab "雀栈", quiet subtitle "大众麻将 · 四人", with only small sound/settings icons at the right. Restrained Chinese typography and legible concise text. Very narrow DBX host icon rail can appear at far left; gameplay occupies at least 85 percent of the image. No coins, shops, VIP, gems, currencies, daily rewards, casino elements, ornate gold frames, extra side panels, giant banners, tutorials, explanatory arrows or annotation paragraphs. Original UI artwork. Aim for an attractive and realistically implementable game screen with excellent hierarchy, well-spaced controls and refined tile materials. Direction A: 青瓷工作台, the recommended direction. A tactile, tranquil jade-and-slate workbench game, mature and beautifully crafted. Slate blue-gray app frame (#1b2931), desaturated mineral teal playing surface (#284f51), warm ivory ceramic tile faces (#f2f1e9), muted celadon green tile sides and green active accent (#88c4ad), traditional cinnabar red tile marks (#bc5148). Gentle overhead light, subtle ceramic bevels and tight contact shadows. A clean rounded rectangular table, close-to-top-down view with only a small 3D tilt, natural depth on the tiles. One very subtle inset line and tiny registration-corner marks integrate the board with DBX. The central wind compass resembles an understated four-port connection control, geometric and readable, not neon. Slate cloth has barely visible fine woven texture. Seat avatars are simple restrained geometric colored marks, no faces. The table should feel physically satisfying yet visually very quiet. No gratuitous glowing gradients, no large card containers. The tiny brand beside DBX reads "雀栈" in an elegant Chinese font. Render this one complete screen, all controls and human tiles comfortably visible.

Realistic Chinese Mahjong table geometry and a much quieter, compact header. Render this one complete screen.

Real Chinese Mahjong faces are colorful and extremely readable, not washed out. View the whole four-seat table near top-down with slight 3D extrusion on the tiles. A slim white DBX tab bar with one little teal active underline, tiny geometric database-shaped seat avatars beside the labels MySQL, PostgreSQL and Redis, blue-green presence dots. Avoid beige editorial layouts, decorative plants, illustrated landscapes, gold or heavy black panels, round playing-card table outlines. Render this one complete screen.
